text:
sam: Heads-up — incoming customer request for a bespoke instruct build with 200k context and int4 quant. They want parity with hosted instruct on instruction-following metrics. Can we triage feasibility?

anya: tagging @liam @maria. Do we have a perf estimate for 200k with int4? I expect KV cache blow-up.

liam: 200k is borderline. Memory for 200k tokens (per request) will need sharded KV and sequence chunking. With int4 we might hit accuracy regression. Quick numbers: single A100-80GB -> not feasible. Need multi-GPU or offload.

maria: timeline: customer needs POC in 3 weeks. Priority if they're enterprise. @sam can you confirm contract & region?

sam: yes enterprise, EU region required. They asked for canary in staging first.

anya: proposed plan:
1) run quality baseline on 32k & 64k instruct variants
2) run quantization sweep int8->int4 with calibration prompts
3) run longseq KV sharding + chunked decoding
4) perf bench on dedicated cluster

liam: we should add fallback policy: if int4 regresses >2% on instr-follow, fall back to int8.

ops-bot: perf-run queued: run_id 8942. Dataset: cust_bespoke_suite_v1 (includes instruction-follow, safety checks, prompt-perturbations)

eva: small note — for EU data residency use private deployment or dedicated EU nodes. I'll triage infra.

anya: quick config snippet for the build:
```
model: bespoke-2026-instruct
context: 200000
quant: int4
shard_kv: true
fallback_policy: int8_on_regress
```

liam: also need eval harness to include synthetic context boundary tests (token dropout, roll-over). I'll add to the suite.

sam: ok let's sync in 30m with infra + PM. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria: adding to roadmap board and creating a customer PRD.

anya: I'll start the quant sweep and share results in this thread.

(ops-bot reaction :white_check_mark:)
